facts.title: angel hair pasta with raw tomato sauce
ingredients: 3 pounds fresh, best-quality tomatoes (results are uneven with less fresh ones)
2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice or red wine vinegar
1 teaspoon coarse salt, plus more to taste
1 pound dried capellini or angel-hair spaghetti
To serve: grated ricotta salata or Parmigiano-Reggiano and a drizzle of your favorite olive oil
facts.author: Deb Perelman
